name: 98421 · Tacoma, WA
findings: ZIP 98421 (Tacoma) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98421 (Tacoma) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
